payload.content: A wedding photography and film WordPress portfolio showcasing films, photography, couple stories and galleries before guiding prospective couples towards an enquiry.
payload.description_1: Ozturkmotionpictures has to win trust through creative work, but couples still need practical information before choosing a wedding filmmaker. A showreel communicates style, but it does not explain what is included, how the service works or how someone can make contact.
payload.description_2: I placed Ozturkmotionpictures' film work at the centre of the WordPress experience, then added service context around the moments when a couple is likely to ask practical questions. Wedding films and visual examples establish the creative direction first, while concise explanations clarify the offer without interrupting the viewing experience.
